wdg-bank-agent.description:
WDG data platform MCP server — 45 tools for the 3 live brands (gelatomiiix / bonjur / tamkoko).

**Modules (9)**:
1. **银行流水 (bank-txn)** — upload_bank_txn_file · get_unclassified_transactions · get_txn_detail · get_candidates · get_rules · preview_match · submit_proposal · get_pipeline_kpi · get_coverage_by_file · get_unclassified_by_file · rerun_match_by_file
2. **审批 (approval)** — submit_proposal · get_proposal · query_approval_status · get_rules_history
3. **门店月报 (store-report)** — query_store_report_snapshot · query_store_report_trend
4. **财务报表 (financial)** — query_financial_statement (profit/cashflow/balance_sheet) · query_financial_overview · query_financial_kpi_trend · query_counterparty · query_income_metrics · query_payment_metrics · query_qimai_revenue
5. **收入分析 (income)** — upload_gelatomiiix_income_detail · upload_bonjur_income_detail · query_gelatomiiix_income · get_qimai_entry_rate
6. **销售分析 (sales)** — upload_bonjur_product_sales · upload_bonjur_sales_self_service · query_bonjur_qimai_sales · query_bonjur_sales_summary (overview/trend/channels) · query_bonjur_sales_products · query_bonjur_sales_details · query_gelatomiiix_sales_overview · query_gelatomiiix_sales_trend · query_gelatomiiix_sales_channels · query_gelatomiiix_sales_products · query_gelatomiiix_sales_details · query_gelatomiiix_sales_distribution · query_gelatomiiix_sales_hourly
7. **Tamkoko 库存** — upload_tamkoko_inventory
8. **元数据** — get_brand_stores · list_categories · list_rule_groups · list_rule_files
9. **跳过 (NOT exposed)** — xintiandi (template schema not deployed), export_rules (xlsx binary), all rule-write / approval-action / batch-rerun APIs (Agent must submit proposals; humans settle/approve)

**Brands** (3 real): gelatomiiix (alias: yufeng) | bonjur | tamkoko.
**Stores** (7): gelatomiiix: sh_sc, sh_xtd · bonjur: sh_wdg, wz_ra, wz_wxc · tamkoko: hz_fuyang, wz_bjwxc.
**Agent write policy**: only `submit_proposal` / `rerun_match_by_file` / `upload_*` are exposed. All rule CRUD, approval decisions, and config changes stay human-gated.

Full tool reference: docs/mcp-tools.md
